queries: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_total_cost END), 0) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_invoice_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT s.invoice_number, s.avg_quantity, s.relative_gap, s.avg_quantity - o.avg_invoice_quantity AS quantity_above_overall_average FROM invoice_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_quantity > o.avg_invoice_quantity ORDER BY quantity_above_overall_average IS NULL, quantity_above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL(19,4))) AS avg_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) AS avg_invoice_quantity FROM invoice_stats) SELECT s.invoice_number, s.avg_quantity, s.relative_gap, s.avg_quantity - o.avg_invoice_quantity AS quantity_above_overall_average FROM invoice_stats AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_quantity > o.avg_invoice_quantity ORDER BY quantity_above_overall_average IS NULL, quantity_above_overall_average DESC LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS DECIMAL(38,10))) AS average_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_product_cost END) AS product_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL THEN derived_total_cost END) AS total_cost FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average FROM invoice_metrics), results AS (SELECT m.invoice_number, m.average_quantity, (m.product_cost - m.total_cost) / NULLIF(m.total_cost, 0) AS relative_gap, m.average_quantity - o.overall_average AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_metrics m CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE m.average_quantity > o.overall_average) SELECT invoice_number, average_quantity, relative_gap, quantity_difference FROM results ORDER BY CASE WHEN quantity_difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Product quantities are numeric strings or NULL. The invoice-level relative gap is calculated from summed costs, using lines where both costs are present.

alternatives.interpretation: Give each line item equal weight by averaging its relative gap within the invoice.

assumptions.assumption: Nonblank product_quantity values contain numeric text.
An invoice's relative gap is the ratio of its summed costs, using line items where both costs are present.

alternatives.interpretation: The invoice's relative gap is the average of its line-item relative gaps.

assumptions.assumption: The invoice's relative gap compares its summed product costs with its summed total costs. Blank quantity strings are treated as missing.

alternatives.interpretation: The invoice's relative gap is the average of its line items' relative gaps, ignoring lines with missing costs or zero total cost.
alternatives.sql: WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS average_quantity, AVG((derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS relative_gap FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average FROM invoice_metrics) SELECT invoice_number, average_quantity, relative_gap, average_quantity - overall_average AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_metrics CROSS JOIN overall WHERE average_quantity > overall_average ORDER BY quantity_difference IS NULL, quantity_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
